violations.affected_code: icon: colorSelected.color == ColorSeed.values[i].color && colorSelectionMethod == ColorSelectionMethod.colorSeed ? const Icon(Icons.circle) : const Icon(Icons.radio_button_unchecked)
violations.explanation: The selected color is indicated only visually by swapping icons (filled circle vs. unchecked radio). The IconButton does not expose a selected/checked state (e.g., via Semantics(selected: ...) or isSelected), so screen reader users cannot tell which color seed is currently selected.

The grid behaves as a single-choice radio group for color selection, but each option is exposed only as a generic button without radio/in-mutually-exclusive-group semantics, so the single-selection nature of the control is not conveyed.
